items.review_rationale: Read the iff diagonal-closed characterization of a Hausdorff topological space in the binary product topology, distinguishing a diagonal subset from an arbitrary closed graph.

references.context: Set of ordered pairs of equal entries, regarded as subset of X×X.
Set whose complement is open in the product topology.

references.phrase: Hausdorff if and only if diagonal closed
references.disposition: Equivalent topological criterion, not extra requirement on top of the disjoint-open-neighborhood definition.

items.review_rationale: Read the faithful flatness predicate as both preservation and reflection of exactness of arbitrary module sequences by the tensor functor, distinct from flatness alone.

references.context: Endofunctor from R-modules to R-modules formed by tensoring each object and morphism with M.
If a tensor-transformed module sequence is exact, then the original sequence was exact; stronger than preservation.

references.disposition: Faithful flatness requires both directions for arbitrary module sequences; applying M to a single exact sequence is not sufficient.
